quote: The Skolem problem is named after Thoralf Skolem, because of his 1933 paper proving the Skolem–Mahler–Lech theorem on the zeros of a sequence satisfying a linear recurrence with constant coefficients.
note: The problem arises from Skolem's 1933 foundational work on the Skolem–Mahler–Lech theorem, which characterizes when linear recurrence sequences have zeros. The theorem itself was proven in that paper, but the proofs do not show how to algorithmically test for the existence of zeros, which formulates the Skolem problem.
